summary: Iovance Biotherapeutics filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 29, 2026, disclosing a press release that raised full-year 2026 total revenue guidance to $410-$420 million from the prior $350-$370 million range, a $55 million or roughly 15% increase at the midpoint, implying nearly 60% annual growth. The raise reflects strong U.S. demand for Amtagvi (lifileucel) and Proleukin and manufacturing schedule visibility. Interim CEO Frederick Vogt cited a record $99.3 million second-quarter 2026 product revenue. No transaction, solicitation, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are present; this is an ordinary operational guidance update, not a special situation.
